COVID: Masks for All [5657]

By: Carol Albertyn Christie | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Further information:
Masks for All?

Initially we were told to wear a mask, people in panic went out and bought all the stock and there has been no masks for medical personnel. We were then told that only the sick should wear masks and those that are healthy shouldn’t.

We should look at the Czech Republick example.
In 3 days they made 10 million face masks to protect their people and it significantly brought down the spread of the virus. Compared to Italy and Spain their stats are significantly lower.
They are following social distancing and the rule of staying at home, other countries do that too. They also have strict hygienic procedures other countries do that too. The main difference is that everyone who has to leave their house has to wear a face mask.
Even a home made mask can be partially protective.
(As a family we are making ours today)
Todays stats Italy 97 689 infected with 10 779 decesed,
Spain 80 110 infected with 6803 fatalities and
Czech Rep with 2817 infected with 16 fatalities.

https://medium.com/@Cancerwarrior/covid-19-why-we-should-all-wear-masks-there-is-new-scientific-rationale-280e08ceee71
(Jeremy Howard is a distinguished research scientist at the University of San Francisco, founding researcher at fast.ai and a member of the World Economic Forum's Global AI Council.) We can use this video.

Masks prevent transmission of you to others, by sneezing, coughing but also by breathing. The most contagious people are the ones just before they start showing symptoms. When people wear facemasks they protect themselves and fellow humans.

From their scientific studies, masks can protect from microdroplets, these are small droplets of muscous that contain the virus. The virus is much smaller than the holes in the fabric but they are transported in the micro droplets which are caught by the fabric of the mask.

More people who wear masks, less droplets can be transmitted and fewer individuals exposed. In Czech Republik people started making masks and giving them to others for free. They hung them on street lights for people to take when they needed them. It became a huge home industry.

They believe that face masks work and it has been confirmed by scientists.
In the video link that I have sent above.

Message of wearing a mask has been spread by social media, by influencers. Everyone wears a mask and their stats have shown a significant drop.

https://www.praguemorning.cz/usage-of-masks-flattened-growth-of-coronavirus-cases-in-czech-republic/

https://www.washingtonpost.com/outlook/2020/03/28/masks-all-coronavirus/

Issues
- Contradictory messages. Wear and don’t wear.
- No stock. Run on buying masks
- Medical personnel don’t have masks.
- Masks price increase. Exploitation
- Understanding the virus
- Workers in shops don’t have proper protection gear.
- Countries that have worn masks have flattened curve.
- How far droplets spread


People to interview all Durban

Dr Pieter Desmarais – ENT will be able to talk about how the virus is spread and absorbed. Concerned about lack of equipment. Looking at new research.


Margie Desmerais – Dr Pieter’s sister who is making masks and giving them to the needy.

Prof Salim Abdool Karim – World Acclaimed Researcher Durban Epidimiologist. Belives that carona will ranl as one of the four greatest epidemics in history of mankind. Black Death (bubonic plague), Spanish Flu and HIV each of them had mortality rates that ran into millions. ( Article on him in Sunday Tribune)

YouTube Videos of mentioned researchers , Jeremy Howard. I am sure in public interest we can use these videos.

Presenter to stay at home in front of computer.

Manager of Hospitals in Umhlanga.

Videos of how to make own masks.

Go onto streets and at shops and see how many people are wearing masks.

Use graphics of how it is spread.

Look at stats of countries who are using masks.
